thread:
jules: Quick thread 1: OrionFlux signed off verbally on a short case vignette + webinar mention. Need: a short approved quote, recording slot, legal consent, and lead routing for the webinar signups. Brief: https://drive.redwood.com/orionflux-brief

rowan: I can take the interview. Rowan (CS) available Thu 11am PT for 25 minutes. Will prep three talking points focused on cost, latency, and dev integration.

nicole: Production here 1: Thu 11am PT works. I'll set Zoom + Otter, plan a 90s promo + 15s teaser. Do we want subtitles and OE caption burn?

jules: Yes to subtitles. Also need a 2-line hero quote for the site. Rowan, can you ask the customer for a 1-sentence executive quote and explicit consent on the call?

marcus-sales: On routing: we'll want webinar signups to create leads with utm_campaign=orionflux-launch and a hidden product_interest=orionflux. SF queue = SDR_OrionFlux. Also create a lead owner rule for AE team if company size > 500.

ida-legal: Legal note: we require an explicit consent line that outlines uses (case page, social, webinar repurposing). Any metric must include the measurement window and that it's based on aggregated production workload. No absolute or comparative claims without substantiation. Paste the exact quote here once you have it.

samir: I'll collect the 1-line quote and consent on the call. Also confirm: they only shared aggregated monthly stats, no raw logs.

nicole: Sending calendar invite now. I'll include a prep doc: 3 bullets, ask them to approve the 90s clip + 15s teaser on the call.

jules: Draft quote candidate to suggest on the call: "OrionFlux's deployment reduced our inference costs by about 40% and cut p95 latency from ~750ms to ~210ms across our August production workload." 1: Please shorten if needed.

ida-legal: Prefer shortened hero: "We cut inference costs ~40% and p95 latency from ~750ms to ~210ms on our August production workload." Also add consent template: "By approving this quote, OrionFlux grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote and associated case study materials (transcript excerpts, short video clips, and summary statistics) for marketing and sales collateral."

marcus-sales: Confirmed SF queue and lead field plan. I'll set the form fields and automation today.

redwood-bot: Reminder: submit /legal-review with final quote + consent. SLA 48 hours.

jules: Action items:
- Rowan: capture 1-sentence exec quote + consent on call (due EOD Thu)
- Nicole: recording + promo assets + subtitles (invite sent)
- Marcus: implement form + lead routing (SDR_OrionFlux + utm & product_interest)
- Ida: legal review once quote submitted (48h SLA)
- Samir: confirm metrics are aggregated only (no raw logs)

rowan: On it. I'll push for a short executable line during the call and drop the consent text into the chat.

jules: Tentative timeline: publish case vignette the week after next, social promo the same day, webinar 7-10 days after publish. If legal returns redlines, we shift by a week. Everyone ok? :thumbsup: 

marcus-sales: Sounds good. Will notify SDRs when automation is live.

ida-legal: I'll review right after you post the final quote. Standard perpetual marketing permission is fine unless they insist on an embargo window.

redwood-bot: Task created: "OrionFlux case + legal" assigned to ida-legal, due in 48h after submission.
